_comment: Retired content URLs and where their intent now lives.
Every entry is a permanent 301 to the closest SEMANTIC replacement — never a
blanket sweep into /blog/. A reader who searched for 'mining claims map
Nevada' and lands on the blog index has been given a 404 with a nicer
`patterns` are Vercel path-to-regexp sources, used where one rule can retire
a whole generated family. `exact` handles the individual pages.
scripts/generate-blog.js reads this file to emit vercel.json's redirects AND
to assert that nothing it generates collides with a retired URL, so a page
cannot be resurrected by a data edit without the build failing.

patterns._note: 28 geographic permutations of one drill template. Every one of them targeted the same job — plot collars, label intercepts, export a figure — with the region name swapped. That job is one guide.

Catch-all for the 21 mining-claims-map regions where Exploration Maps has no jurisdiction-specific claim functionality: US states, Alberta, Nova Scotia, NWT, Western Australia, Chile, Peru, Mexico, South Africa, Ghana. The seven supported jurisdictions are listed in `exact` above and match first.
